scene: Your coin triggers dazzling fountains, revealing three exotic transit stations beyond.
picture: Flat side view. Along the piazza ground, a silver-haired grandmother in a pink tracksuit holds her white dog's lead beside the spouting fountain. On the far left, a gondola drone waits at a pier. Up high sits an elevated glass hover metro. On the far right idles a red double-decker hover bus.
shown: a sleek canal gondola drone bobbing at a low dock on the far left
a gleaming glass hover metro pod waiting at an elevated track up high
